event.title: Oddpool was introduced
event.summary: Oddpool introduced Oddpool, the institutional data layer for prediction markets, backed by @ycombinator.

sourcePreview.title: Introducing the Oddpool Macro Feed. One websocket. every macro event. real-time probability data from Kalshi and Polymarket, normalized into a single stream. Built for institutions. Free to connect.
